analytic_model.field: delta_a^s=A_a(k,mu,z) delta_cb + c_{a,F}(k,z) v_nucdm_parallel,R16,F + epsilon_a, a=L,E
analytic_model.allowed: A_a real even in mu; c_a real, mu-even and unknown; P_delta,v=+i mu C_v,F from original E12/E13, P_dd and P_vv real even; illustrative deterministic component epsilon omitted from analytic equations, not asserted physically uncorrelated in eBOSS.
analytic_model.cross: P_LE = A_L A_E P_dd + c_L c_E P_vv + i mu (A_L c_E-A_E c_L) C_v
analytic_model.auto: P_aa=A_a^2 P_dd+c_a^2 P_vv, when delta-v cross purely imaginary
analytic_model.all_order_even_sign: Simultaneously replacing (c_L,c_E) by (-c_L,-c_E) leaves BOTH auto power and real LE cross invariant exactly within this deterministic two-field model at all orders in c; imaginary odd reverses sign. No universal claim with other coupled fields, nuisance cross or beyond linear response.
analytic_model.first_order_even_null: The derivative of auto power and real cross power wrt each c evaluated at c_L=c_E=0 is exactly zero; odd cross derivative is nonzero if mu C_v and tracer-contrast coefficients nonzero.
analytic_model.odd_rank: At fixed (k,mu,z,F), odd LE provides only chi_F=A_L c_E-A_E c_L; (c_L,c_E)->(c_L,c_E)+t(A_L,A_E) leaves chi invariant. Even spectra at O(c^2) can add constraints but not simultaneous global c sign in this restricted model.
analytic_model.original_4K: Use all original E21 four K and original FD,Fplus,Fminus physical C_v (km/s)Mpc^3 at mathematical z=.95; no interpolation or eBOSS 24D xi conversion.
analytic_model.survey_limit: Only source-level k-space projection, no calibrated c_L,c_E, physical high-z HOD/host histories, Doppler/evolution/magnification selection, signed full redshift pair operator, extra relativistic terms, or measured odd. Published HOD mass/velocity scatter does not measure c_nucdm.

new_QA_before_execution: Exact Git blob check for all three pinned source files and originally sealed E21/E22.
All 3 original F states and 4 original E21 physical-unit long K are parsed, positive, original signed + versus - contrast unchanged.
Exact rational complex spectral formula for auto and cross validates Hermiticity under LE/EL exchange and odd mu reversal.
At c=0, first-order even derivatives zero; nonzero odd linear response if chi and mu C_v nonzero; quadratic c^2 even correction explicitly present.
Simultaneous sign reversal of c_L and c_E leaves exact auto and Re(P_LE) unchanged, flips Im(P_LE) even at finite rational c.
Rank-null transformation (c_L,c_E)+t(A_L,A_E) preserves chi and hence odd but may change even c^2, so do not assert full-data null.
Independent two-state halo occupation marginal counterexample same one-tracer marginals different pair-environment correlation; explicitly toy/not actual high-z HOD.

At least seven deliberately tampered negative controls including false even-linear, fake odd sign invariance, mistaken EL reversal, false HOD mass-mean identifiability, absent parent source and invalid original K.
